name: USDCHF Mean Reversion Low Volatility
description: Long-only mean reversion strategy on USDCHF that enters when price deviates 1% below its 50-period SMA during low volatility periods (daily ATR below its 10-period average), and exits when price reverts to the SMA.
source:
# USDCHF Mean Reversion Low Volatility Strategy
# Long-only mean reversion that enters when:
# 1. Daily ATR < 10-period MA of daily ATR (low volatility)
# 2. Close is at least 1% below 50-period SMA on 4H bars
# Exit when price crosses back above the 50-period SMA

# 4H data source (main timeframe for strategy)
src_4h = market_data_source(timeframe=4H)()
close = src_4h.c
high = src_4h.h
low = src_4h.l

# Note: Daily ATR calculated using atr() with timeframe parameter
# atr() fetches its own data internally when timeframe is specified

# =============================================================================
# INDICATORS ON 4H TIMEFRAME
# =============================================================================

# 50-period SMA on 4H bars
sma_50 = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# Entry threshold: 1% below SMA
entry_threshold = sma_50 * 0.99

# Price deviation condition (close is at least 1% below SMA)
price_below_sma = close < entry_threshold

# =============================================================================
# DAILY VOLATILITY FILTER
# =============================================================================

# Daily ATR (14-period) - atr fetches its own OHLC data
daily_atr = atr(period=14, timeframe=1D)()

# 10-period MA of daily ATR
daily_atr_ma = ma(period=10, type=MAType.sma)(daily_atr)

# Low volatility condition: current ATR < its 10-period average (on daily)
low_volatility_daily = daily_atr < daily_atr_ma

# Convert boolean to numeric for upsampling (1.0 = low vol, 0.0 = high vol)
low_volatility_numeric = 1.0 if low_volatility_daily else 0.0

# Upsample daily volatility signal to 4H timeframe
low_volatility_4h = upsample_by_interpolate(target_timeframe=4H)(low_volatility_numeric)

# Convert back to boolean
low_volatility = low_volatility_4h > 0.5

# =============================================================================
# ENTRY & EXIT SIGNALS
# =============================================================================

# Entry: both conditions must be true
# 1. Low volatility on daily
# 2. Price at least 1% below 50-SMA on 4H
entry_signal = price_below_sma and low_volatility

# Exit: price crosses back above the 50-period SMA (mean reversion complete)
exit_signal = crossover(close, sma_50)

# =============================================================================
# POSITION MANAGEMENT
# =============================================================================

# Convert entry/exit pulses to held position signal
held_long = hold_until()(enter=entry_signal, exit=exit_signal)

# Long zone executor
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long)

# =============================================================================
# RISK MANAGEMENT - 2% fixed stop loss
# =============================================================================

# Stop loss distance: 2% from entry
stop_distance = close * 0.02

# Apply stop loss
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.price)(distance=stop_distance)

# =============================================================================
# POSITION SIZING - 1-2% risk per trade
# =============================================================================

# Using risk_unit for risk-based position sizing
# Risk 1.5% of equity per trade (middle of 1-2% range)
risk_unit(
    rr_ratio=2.0,
    stop_unit=StopUnit.price
)(
    risk_pct=1.5,
    stop_distance=stop_distance
)
